facts.name: Foxglove Beardtongue
facts.notes: Clouds of white tubular flowers in early summer over glossy leaves. A favorite of bumblebees.

sources.title: Michigan Wildflower Farm: Dryland species list
sources.note: Michigan seed grower; marks any species that is not native to Michigan.

companions.why: Combines well with blue spiderworts, blue false indigo and prairie dropseed; try it with catmint and lady's mantle.
